snippet.title: MELODY | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
A game designed with intention to reward you for remaining calm and centered as you play.  Play Free at https://melodythegame.com

Melody is a physics based, zero gravity game that is equal parts puzzle and skill.  Melody has been designed from the ground up to be an ASMR and Zen experience to show the value of remaining calm, patient and methodical in your actions.

This trailer for the early access release of Melody shows off some brief clips of the kinetic, zero gravity gameplay a player can expect.  Melody Early Access is entirely ad free and free to play.  We would LOVE to hear your thoughts on the game and please let us know of any bugs or issues you discover.
